payload: Act as the branch-cleanup worker for fengie/mhw-mods. Fetch origin with prune and inspect current remote main before any mutation. Delete only remote branches that are already merged, superseded by newer main work, or are temporary integration branches whose PR is merged. Specifically evaluate agent/control-test-narrow-test-scope-only-build-a-r-20260928133350-vrokm (PR #136 merged), agent/launch-observation-atomicity-20260928 (selectively ported by merged PR #137), integration/launch-observation-atomicity-main-20260929 (PR #137 head), fix/codex-quota-dispatch-circuit-20260929 (PR #130 merged), agent/swarm-contract-v3-20260929-0540 (main has newer prompt templates), agent/bridge-uia-native-20260929 (superseded by merged UIA hardening/current worker v4), and agent-bridge (obsolete pre-v4 bridge implementation). Do NOT delete main. Do NOT delete heaven-bridge because it is the live queue/result transport branch. Do not delete any branch that has unique unmerged product work or has moved since inspection. Use exact-tip checks before deletion. Afterward fetch --prune again and print a compact JSON report with deleted, skipped, failed, and remaining remote branches.
